description: This file defines the SimpleChannel class used for inter-process communication in Firefox's Juggler system, including transport setup, message handling, and connection management.

classes.name: SimpleChannel
classes.description: A class implementing a message-based communication channel with connection handshake, message buffering, and request handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new SimpleChannel instance with name and uid.

methods.name: bindToActor
methods.description: Binds the channel to an actor, replacing its receiveMessage method.

methods.name: resetTransport
methods.description: Resets the transport to a default state.

methods.name: setTransport
methods.description: Sets the transport object and initiates handshake by sending a 'READY' message.

methods.name: resumeSoon
methods.description: Resumes message processing shortly after being paused.

methods.name: _setTimeout
methods.description: Lazy loads and calls the setTimeout function from Timer module.

methods.name: _markAsReady
methods.description: Marks the channel as ready and sends pending messages.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the channel, rejecting pending messages and cleaning up.

methods.name: _rejectCallbacksFromConnector
methods.description: Rejects pending callbacks associated with a specific connector ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates a connector object for sending and emitting messages.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a handler for a specific namespace.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a handler for a namespace.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends a message over the channel, returning a promise.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, including handshake and responses.

methods.name: _onMessageInternal
methods.description: Processes a message request, invoking handlers and sending responses.
